description: A test script that sets up and runs various git log graph visualization tests, primarily for validating the behavior of the 'git log --graph' command with different options and decorations.

methods.name: check_graph
methods.description: Defines a function to output a graph to a file and compare it with expected output for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up individual commits with specified messages and files, used to build the git history for graph testing.
